Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs multiple proteomics workflows: 1) TMT-labeled DDA/MS3 for whole-cell extracts, 2) LFQ-based diaPASEF for quantitative profiling, and 3) AP-MS (IP-MS) for interaction mapping. The most complex acquisition described is diaPASEF.

scope: For IP-MS experiments, FLAG-tagged HUWE1 or HAPSTR1 expressing cells were resuspended in 50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 200 mM NaCl, 2 mM TCEP, 0.1% NP-40, cOmplete Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (Roche Diagnostics).
Equal concentrations of each sample were incubated with M2-FLAG magnetic beads for 1 h at 4°C.
Bound proteins were eluted with 0.2 mg/mL 1xFLAG peptide (DYKDDDDK) or 50 mM biotin, respectively.
we mapped the physical interactions for HAPSTR1 and HUWE1 using affinity enrichment followed by mass spectrometry.
